verdict.rationale:
Stable offers a dedicated registered agent product that ties into the same account/Organization as the mailbox, explicitly designed for service-of-process and state correspondence handling, with API support to create a registered agent Location under an existing Organization and route mail digitally alongside virtual mailbox items. This directly matches the founder's need for bundled registered agent + mailbox service.

missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of pricing bundling or explicit statement that registered agent is included (vs. add-on) in a specific mailbox plan tier.
